three.js r160 (npm package 0.160.1)
Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
License: MIT (see THREE-LICENSE.txt)
Vendored runtime: three.module.js

The application uses three.js for scene geometry, materials, lighting, shadows,
camera projection, and Raycaster-based board picking. Its renderer setup and
pointer-to-ray workflow follow the project's official interactive examples:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r160/examples/webgl_interactive_cubes.html

The Gomoku board, temple scene, interface, state handling, and Python API
integration are adapted for this experiment. No runtime CDN is required.
